summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover for i.tekin@aegean.edu. The account's only prior sign-in was from the university network (AS-AEGEAN-EDU, Manisa, TR, device DEV-H01-D). On 2026-10-12, 15 rapid successful sign-ins (~every 2.5 min) originated from 203.0.113.58 (Contabo GmbH hosting, Nuremberg, DE) across portal/mail/sis apps with empty device_id and zero MFA prompts — impossible travel, unfamiliar cloud ASN, automated pattern, and MFA bypass/absence. Immediately after (02:16:40), a mail forwarding rule was created via API forwarding to external l1b-archive@protonmail.com, a classic exfiltration action. Combined indicators (new geo/ASN, rapid auth bursts, missing device, no MFA, external forwarding rule) confirm compromise; contain the account (disable, password reset, revoke sessions, remove forwarding rule).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
